question: risks

evidence.title: Webhook retries stampede Stripe
evidence.author: arjun
evidence.snippet: invoice.paid handler isn't idempotent. Stripe retry + our own 3x retry = 6 charges on a slow webhook. Need a processed_events table keyed on event id.  Saw this in the 7 Aug incident, ~40 duplicate invoices.

evidence.title: Empty promo code 500s checkout
evidence.author: meera
evidence.snippet: POST /checkout dies with 500 if promo_code is "". We used to treat blank as no promo. Staging repro: add item, leave promo field empty (not omitted), pay.  Stack is in the thread. Happened twice for enterprise trial accounts this week.

evidence.title: Document VAT for EU self-serve
evidence.author: priya
evidence.snippet: Legal wants a one-pager before we turn on EU. Blocked on tax vendor pick — still Stripe Tax vs. Avalara, no decision.

evidence.title: Export CSV silently drops refunds
evidence.author: meera
evidence.snippet: Finance noticed Q2 export didn't include refunds after 12 Jun. Fixed in #29. Left this open until they signed off — they did on 28 Jul.

evidence.title: Q3 goal: cut checkout p95 under 400ms
evidence.author: priya
evidence.snippet: We're at ~620ms p95 on checkout. Biggest chunk is the promo service (sync HTTP). Plan was to cache by code, but empty-string bug (#41) should land first or we cache the bad path.

evidence.title: Idempotent webhook consumer
evidence.author: arjun
evidence.snippet: Draft. Adds processed_events and bails if stripe event id is already there. Not wired to checkout yet. Depends on #38.

evidence.title: Don't 500 on blank promo_code
evidence.author: meera
evidence.snippet: Treat null and "" as no code. Adds a test. Does not add caching — that's a follow up for #22.

answer:
Issues
- Webhook retries stampede Stripe (open) [#38]: invoice.paid handler isn't idempotent. Stripe retry + our own 3x retry = 6 charges on a slow webhook. Need a processed_events table keyed on event id.
- Empty promo code 500s checkout (open) [#41]: POST /checkout dies with 500 if promo_code is "". We used to treat blank as no promo. Staging repro: add item, leave promo field empty (not omitted), pay.
- Document VAT for EU self-serve (open) [#18]: Legal wants a one-pager before we turn on EU. Blocked on tax vendor pick — still Stripe Tax vs. Avalara, no decision.
- Export CSV silently drops refunds (closed) [#33]: Finance noticed Q2 export didn't include refunds after 12 Jun. Fixed in #29. Left this open until they signed off — they did on 28 Jul.
- Q3 goal: cut checkout p95 under 400ms (open) [#22]: We're at ~620ms p95 on checkout. Biggest chunk is the promo service (sync HTTP). Plan was to cache by code, but empty-string bug (#41) should land first or we cache the bad path.
Pull requests
- Idempotent webhook consumer (open) [#14]: Draft. Adds processed_events and bails if stripe event id is already there. Not wired to checkout yet. Depends on #38.
- Don't 500 on blank promo_code (open) [#12]: Treat null and "" as no code. Adds a test. Does not add caching — that's a follow up for #22.
